evidence.reason: revalidated: CORRECTED ENTRY, supersedes my earlier journal entry for this job whose claim that the case remains absent from both files was wrong; the wrong entry was disclosed to the leads and replaced before projection. PR #1547 published fix removed the host-dependent platform-time-error utilization case (now=1e18 overflow classifying differently across platforms) from fixtures/a1-status/emit.py and utilization.json. A later merged repair for a different finding (commit 2a7406f61, finding ca6d875e519f2a2a86762d04f58cc0b76948756310be5983c5390cda97c51217, 2026-11-12) deliberately re-added the case in a platform-robust form: exception class kept, platform-dependent expect.message deleted (emit.py:1500-1505 with the libc-variance comment; the differential runner skips the message so --check stays byte-identical per host). Verified against current origin/main e181cf0e87337992289ed3980c34e0563389648c: the host-independence property the published fix established holds in the current re-added shape, so the fix's intent is preserved rather than reverted. Canonical finding delivered; PR #1547 MERGED with published head ancestor of merge.
